# voetlab

> voetlab is a standalone, copyable football video-analytics framework (Python 3.10+):
> broadcast video → player/ball detection, tracking, pitch calibration, events, physical and
> tactical stats, a per-stat reliability signal, and charts. Every feature returns a `Result`
> success-indicator, every event carries frame provenance, and each file has a co-located
> footage-driven test. It is the engine behind voetlab.nl.

voetlab is a self-contained package. One feature per file, folder per domain, a
dependency-ordered pipeline runner with single-feature isolation, and a graceful-failure model
(a failing feature is flagged, never crashes the run).

Key entry points:
- `voetlab.run(video, meta=...)` / `voetlab.run_feature(name, video)` — full pipeline or one stage
- `python -m voetlab.report <video>` — one-command report (`stats.json` + `reliability.json` + charts)
- `python -m pytest voetlab -q` — 121 tests

High-recall ball detection (SAHI + a specialist football-ball model ≈ 98% vs ~1% for COCO) is
opt-in via `meta["ball_model_path"]`; accurate metric calibration (TVCalib full camera solver)
via `meta["calib_checkpoint"]` + `meta["tvcalib_path"]` — without these, the pipeline degrades
gracefully (pixels instead of metres; standard YOLO ball).

## Model weights

Model weights are NOT bundled in git (large binaries). Fetch them from the canonical host
**https://voetlab.nl/models/** into a local `models/` dir and pass the paths via `meta`:

- `yolov8s.pt` → `meta["model_path"]` — default YOLO detector (persons + ball)
- `martinjolif_ball.pt` → `meta["ball_model_path"]` — SAHI football-ball model (~98% recall)
- `tvcalib_calib_train59.pt` → `meta["calib_checkpoint"]` — TVCalib full camera solver → metres
- alternate ball models: `rajatdave_ball.pt`, `yaku_ball.pt`

```bash
for f in yolov8s.pt martinjolif_ball.pt tvcalib_calib_train59.pt; do
  curl -L -o "models/$f" "https://voetlab.nl/models/$f"
done
```

Full manifest (sizes, purposes, runtime keys) in `models/README.md`.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): Install, quickstart, layout, conventions.
- [Development log](docs/DEVELOPMENT_LOG.md): How the framework was built — phases, measured quality wins, decisions, and bugfixes (the calibration deep-dive is the most instructive).
- [Build-from-scratch guide](docs/BUILD_FROM_SCRATCH.md): Ordered, TDD-locked todos to reproduce the exact framework (target: 121 tests green).
- [Feature manifest](FEATURES.md): Auto-generated one-line summary of every feature file.
- [HTML docs site](docs/site/index.html): Self-contained reference (sidebar nav, search, per-feature quality cards).

## Per-domain guides

- [core](voetlab/core/README.md): `Result` success-indicator, frame provenance, footage test harness.
- [detection](voetlab/detection/README.md): YOLO detection + the validated high-recall `detect_ball` (SAHI).
- [tracking](voetlab/tracking/README.md): player/ball trackers, Kalman trajectory, team classifier (circular hue), role filter, tracker factory.
- [calibration](voetlab/calibration/README.md): homography engine, keypoints, TVCalib solver → metres.
- [events](voetlab/events/README.md): possession/passes/tackles, every event frame-provenanced.
- [stats](voetlab/stats/README.md): physical + aggregate stats (pixels + metres).
- [tactics](voetlab/tactics/README.md): pitch control + Voronoi (activate when calibrated).
- [reliability](voetlab/reliability/README.md): per-stat confidence (the voetlab signal).
- [viz](voetlab/viz/README.md): mplsoccer chart adapters.
- [pipeline](voetlab/pipeline/README.md): registry, runner (isolation + downstream + compare), default graph, CLI.
